core_obligations: Statement (lines 3707-3712): for a site C, K in SR(C) and F in Sh(C), one has j_*j^{-1}F = SheafHom(F(K)^#, F) where F is the functor attached to K.

Computation (proof lines 3714-3724): for K = {U_i} the descriptions of j^{-1} and j_* give j_*j^{-1}F = product over i of j_{i,*}(F|_{C/U_i}) = product over i of SheafHom(h_{U_i}^#, F), the second equality by the Sites hom-sheaf lemma.

Coproduct-to-product (lines 3724-3733): F(K) = coproduct of the h_{U_i} as presheaves, so F(K)^# = coproduct h_{U_i}^# in sheaves; since SheafHom(-, F) turns coproducts into products (immediate from the Sites glueing construction), the product equals SheafHom(F(K)^#, F).
proof_roadmap: Expand j_*j^{-1}F as the product of the localized pushforwards.
Identify each factor as a Hom sheaf of the sheafified representable.
Use that SheafHom converts coproducts into products to assemble F(K)^#.
difficulty_reason: Push-pull identity (statement 3707-3712, proof 3714-3733): j_*j^{-1}F = SheafHom(F(K)^#, F) - the proof expands the composite functor via the localization descriptions, identifies the factors with Hom sheaves (Sites lemma), and assembles the coproduct of sheafified representables into the product of Hom sheaves; complete three-step computation. H3.
